dedupe_keys.name: eries enfrag state dependent fragility of masonry infills from in plane and out of plane tests eucentre

description: ERIES-ENFRAG is an experimental dataset on how masonry infill walls in reinforced concrete frames lose out-of-plane capacity after earthquake damage in their plane, for building state-dependent fragility models with energy-based approaches. It was published in 2025 by EUCENTRE, the European Centre for Training and Research in Earthquake Engineering in Pavia (Roberto Gentile, Igor Lanese, Riccardo Raimondo Milanesi, Paolo Morandi), within the European ERIES research infrastructure project. Three full-scale infilled frames, with panels 3.50 metres long and 2.75 metres high plastered on one side, were loaded in plane with different cyclic procedures and then shaken out of plane, extending a 2021 campaign whose data are also shared; complementary tests give compressive, shear and flexural properties of the masonry. Coverage: laboratory specimens of one infill type. Access: open download from EUCENTRE's Built Environment Data experiments portal with DOI 10.60756/euc-f8hcyh64. Licence: Creative Commons Attribution 4.0; free. Caveats: three specimens of one masonry and frame configuration. Simulation uses are calibrating state-dependent fragility and sequential-damage models for aftershock and multi-hazard risk. Related records: the RIESGOS state-dependent fragility functions and the EPFL mixed RC and masonry shake table test.
